parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left cabinet door made of wood, part of a storage cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around hinges attached to the cabinet frame.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the cabinet, made of wood, providing structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the entire cabinet structure and bears the load of stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right cabinet door made of wood, part of a storage cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around hinges attached to the cabinet frame.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing structural integrity.
parts.Functional_description: It holds all other parts together and maintains the cabinet’s shape.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf (Bottom)
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom shelf of the cabinet, made of wood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing items inside the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf (Top)
parts.Basic_description: This is the top shelf of the cabinet, made of wood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides an additional surface for organizing stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.
